Name: Unlimited Traveling Cart Item Stock
Author: laurenastrid
Description:
# Unlimited Traveling Cart Stock

Never miss out on a rare find! This mod removes the purchase limit on all Traveling Cart items, letting you buy as many of each as you want whenever the merchant visits.

---

## Installation

1. Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)
2. Download this mod and unzip it into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder
3. Launch the game through SMAPI

---

## Features

- All Traveling Cart items have unlimited stock — no more being limited to one of a rare item per visit
- Works automatically with no configuration needed
- Compatible with other mods that add items to the Traveling Cart

---

## Requirements

- [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/) 4.0.0 or later
- Stardew Valley 1.6.0 or later

---

## Shout Outs

Thanks to the SMAPI and Stardew Valley modding community for their incredible documentation and tools that made this mod possible.
